# Third-party licences

This file lists the licence of every third-party crate (Rust) and npm package (web app) that a Ritma release includes.

**Status:** not generated yet. Ritma has no release. The file is generated by the release pipeline (task T-704) and checked into each release tag. Until then, `Cargo.lock` and `web/pnpm-lock.yaml` are the source of truth, and `cargo deny check licenses` (in CI) rejects any licence outside the allow list in `deny.toml`.
